nodes.name: OpenRouter Models
nodes.notes: Public catalogue, no auth. Feeds the free-model ranking.

nodes.name: Groq Models
nodes.notes: Groq model list (needs the key). Feeds the Groq ranking; failure -> preferred list.

nodes.name: Ensure Collection
nodes.notes: 409 when the collection already exists — expected, hence continue-on-error.

parameters.jsCode: return $('Config').first().json.feeds.map(f => ({ json: f }));

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ids: $json.ids, with_payload: true, with_vector: false }) }}

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/128.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

nodes.name: Embed
nodes.notes: LM Studio only (no free cloud embedding model). If it is down the item passes through with an error and the run degrades to lexical clustering.

nodes.name: Synthesize
nodes.notes: Per story: providers in cfg.provider_order (openrouter -> groq -> lmstudio), models ranked, cooldown breakers, json_schema->json_object retry. Never stops the run.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.notes: Shapes are coerced so this should never throw; if it does, the story is dropped and counted in Run notes instead of killing the run.

nodes.name: OTX Lookup
nodes.notes: OTX is slow/flaky on some indicator types; retries + 60 s timeout. Failures degrade to 'unverified', never stop the run.

nodes.name: Enrich CVEs
nodes.notes: KEV + EPSS + NVD via this.helpers.httpRequest. NVD is throttled to 1 req / 6.5 s; needs N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_TIMEOUT raised.

nodes.name: MISP Sync
nodes.notes: Story ledger in MISP: reuse the event from the prior-story chain or create one (deterministic uuid); push CVEs, sources, ATT&CK tags, IOCs (verdict tags, to_ids for malicious/suspicious); publish; read back the cumulative set. Skipped without MISP_API_KEY.

nodes.name: Discord Post
nodes.notes: multipart: payload_json (embed/content) + files[0] (the binary from Convert to File).
